title: Dell Terraform Provider for PowerStore, versions prior to 1.3.1 , contains a vulnerability that may cause sensitive…
description: Dell Terraform Provider for PowerStore versions prior to 1.3.1 contain a vulnerability that may cause sensitive authentication data to be insufficiently redacted in diagnostic logs. This could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to access sensitive information. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 7.5. No patch information is provided in the data.
